The declared state is deliberately truthful: no inference engine is installed on this host, and the Kimi-K3 weights are not resident on it - so residence is empty and runtimes is empty, and each of those is a refusal in its own right before capacity is ever reached. model.sha256 is a PLACEHOLDER digest, not a measurement: no Kimi-K3 object is held on this host, so there is nothing here whose identity could have been computed. It is present only because placement requires the field, and the refusal this manifest produces does not depend on its value.
